channel.title: Car and Driver - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Car and Driver (caranddriver.com)

item.title: View Exterior Photos of the 2027 Mercedes-Benz S-Class
item.description: Get a thorough look at the glittering exterior of the new Mercedes flagship.

item.title: 2026 Bentley Continental GT S Aims for the Performance Middle Ground
item.description: The new trim level uses the powertrain from the standard GT and chassis upgrades from the more focused Speed models to create a mid-range option.

item.title: Bridgestone Blizzak IcePeak Is a New General-Purpose Winter Tire
item.description: The latest Blizzak winter tire meets a new ice-grip standard and replaces the WS90 and DM-V2 lines.

item.title: Tested: Best Windshield Wiper Blades
item.description: We simulated a cloudburst to test the top wiper blades on the market. Here's what we found—and which wipers surprised us.

item.title: Ram Confirms a Small Work Van Like the ProMaster City Is Coming Back
item.description: It's not as exciting as the return of the TRX, but a new ProMaster City would be the lone entry in the compact-van arena.

item.title: Hyundai Recalls over 568,000 Palisade Family SUVs for the Second Time
item.description: These 2020 to 2025 Palisades have faulty side-curtain airbags, and last year the same models were recalled for defective seatbelts.

item.title: Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road 6MT Test: The Omega Man(ual)
item.description: The Tacoma is the last manual-transmission pickup left on the market. Will it find enough die-hards to keep it alive?

item.title: The Stunning Lexus LC Will Finally Be Laid to Rest Later This Year
item.description: While the writing was on the wall, we now know that Lexus's gorgeous grand tourer will end production this August.

item.title: VW Exec Says the Sportiest Golfs Will Live on with Revamped Engines
item.description: An executive reportedly said VW is working to make the EA888 2.0-liter engine compliant with emissions regulations beyond 2030.

item.title: BMW's Iconic Logo Is Changing, but You Probably Won't Even Notice
item.description: The new BMW roundel debuted on the iX3 EV SUV, and it'll be introduced on other models starting next month.
